The controller works from sensors only. Every rule chooses moves that make progress toward the next unreached goal, and the sensors handle the goal order and the patrol.

```json
  {"condition": "!g3 & !wall & !patrol & !early & !obstacle", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "true", "action": "any"}
```

1. Take safe progress moves first: `toward` and `closer` moves that are not risky, not early, not patrol, and not obstacle.

3. Use a non-patrol, non-early, non-obstacle fallback so every state is covered.
4. Keep the catch-all last.

```json
  {"condition": "!g3 & wall & !patrol & !early & !obstacle", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!g3 & !patrol & !early & !obstacle & !risky", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!g3 & !patrol & !early & !obstacle", "action": "any"},
  {"condition": "!g3 & !early & !obstacle", "action": "any"},

]}
```
